Reorder the sum.
```cpp
// Baseline: port of benchmarks/chebyshev_ckks/chebyshev_ckks.cpp. Generated by llm_loop/gen_baselines.py.

void fhe()
{
  Ciphertext x("x");
  Plaintext alpha("alpha");
  Ciphertext z = x * alpha;
  Plaintext one("one");
  vector<Ciphertext> t(8);
  t[1] = z;
  Ciphertext z_square = z * z;
  t[2] = z_square + z_square - one;
  for (int k = 3; k <= 7; ++k)
  {
    Ciphertext z_t = z * t[k - 1];
    t[k] = z_t + z_t - t[k - 2];
  }
  Plaintext c1("c1");
  Ciphertext result = t[1] * c1;
  Plaintext c2("c2");
  result = result + t[2] * c2;
  Plaintext c4("c4");
  result = result + t[4] * c4;
  Plaintext c6("c6");
  result = result + t[6] * c6;
  Plaintext c0("c0");
  result = c0 + result;
  result.set_output("y");
}
```
